results.question: Show me my total spending per month in 2025 as a line chart.
results.sql:
SELECT
  STRFTIME('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  month
ORDER BY
  month
LIMIT 200

results.question: Zeig den Anteil der groessten Haendler an meinen Ausgaben 2025 als Donut.
results.sql:
WITH top5 AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(counterparty, description) AS merchant,
    ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE
    amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(counterparty, description)
  ORDER BY
    total_eur DESC
  LIMIT 5
), rest_totals AS (
  SELECT
    'REST' AS merchant,
    ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE
    amount < 0
    AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND NOT COALESCE(counterparty, description) IN (
      SELECT
        merchant
      FROM top5
    )
  GROUP BY
    1
), all_totals AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE
    amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  t5.merchant,
  t5.total_eur
FROM top5 AS t5
UNION ALL
SELECT
  rt.merchant,
  rt.total_eur
FROM rest_totals AS rt
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS merchant,
  at.total_eur
FROM all_totals AS at
LIMIT 200

results.question: Chart my spending per quarter in 2025.
results.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN STRFTIME('%Y-%m', booked_on) BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
    THEN '2025-Q1'
    WHEN STRFTIME('%Y-%m', booked_on) BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30'
    THEN '2025-Q2'
    WHEN STRFTIME('%Y-%m', booked_on) BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'
    THEN '2025-Q3'
    ELSE '2025-Q4'
  END AS quarter,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  quarter
ORDER BY
  quarter
LIMIT 200
notes: Repair 1 of 2: Every bar is named by its own label and none may be dropped, so `scales.x` needs `axis: { tickLabels: { thin: false } }`. Add `rotate: -28` beside it once there are more than six names or one of them is long, so they do not overlap.
